finding.summary: Reject empty launch identities in continuity receipts (factory/scripts/factory_lib.py:3711): When a stored measurement-continuity chain contains `launch_id: ""`, this line normalizes it to an empty string and `validated_measurement_launch` consequently skips its launch-ID comparison.
finding.title: Reject empty launch identities in continuity receipts

findings.keep: Keep initial receipt creation able to discover the authentic launch, then require every stored receipt to carry the same safe nonempty launch ID.
findings.reason: Empty stored launch IDs skip the comparison and can substitute a later matching successful launch.

finding.summary: Reject Windows reparse points when hydrating approval authority (factory/scripts/forge_cli/tasks.py:57): When a native Windows checkout contains a junction or other reparse point in the story-approval path, this check accepts it because it rejects only `S_ISLNK` entries and non-directories.
finding.title: Reject Windows reparse points when hydrating approval authority

findings.keep: Keep contained regular single-link stable-byte hydration and leave external targets unchanged on refusal.
findings.reason: Ancestor, leaf, opened-handle, and final identity checks reject POSIX symlinks but never inspect the Windows reparse attribute.

finding.summary: Reject hard-linked migration manifests before writing completion (factory/scripts/forge_cli/upgrade.py:1268): When `.factory/migrations/lean-workflow-v2.json` is a regular hard link, this check accepts it because it tests only `is_symlink()` and `is_file()` and never requires `st_nlink == 1`.
finding.title: Reject hard-linked migration manifests before writing completion

findings.keep: Keep ordinary destination containment and validate again immediately before any in-place completion write.
findings.reason: An existing regular hard-linked manifest passes symlink/file checks and completion truncates the shared outside inode.
